summary: Replace a Method post-save wall-clock threshold with event-gated evidence; await bounded video slot cleanup without changing worker durability or recovery semantics.

components.owning_subsystem: Method semantic resource safety and local video worker lifecycle tests
components.disposition: ADMIT minimal test-only correction; no production runtime, test marker, timeout policy or CI gate changes
evidence: Merged main ea27ecc0 push CI run 43712330211: Method save 138.3ms versus <30ms and video terminal persisted before inherited lock descriptor close
The existing _GatedAPI proves the Method save returns while background embed_batch is blocked
Video worker.py finally publishes job.json before os.close(lock_fd); runtime.job() uses the slot lock for interrupted recovery, so reversing order would create a new interrupted race
components.verification_level: Targeted real worker and Method tests, deterministic gate assertions, repeated targeted runs, independent GLM-5.3 review, original full R9, exact-SHA remote CI
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Independent reviewer may veto the patch on lifecycle or test regressions; return to isolated branch, repair, re-freeze, re-review, and re-run gates before integration.
components.rollback_route: Revert the test-only commit and its manifest; runtime state, deployment, and production services are unchanged.
